newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS SAYS END NEW SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS SAYS END NEW SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Hermis Bank said on Monday that it has sucessfully finished the distribution of a new share issue worth 23 million litas.
"The whole 23 million litas face value share issue was paid last week," Hermis chairwoman Nadiezhda Novickiene told Reuters.
The share capital of Hermis Bank will stand at 90 million litas after the boost.
"Investors paid 150 litas per share with a face value of 50 litas and the 46 million litas share issue difference will increase the total capital of the bank," Novickiene added.
Hermis held a roadshow last week to present its new share issue, part of which will be sold via global depository receipts (GDRs) by investment bank Williams De Broe.
"We expect that 8.1 million litas face value of shares will be distributed in GDRs by Williams de Broe no later than August 1," Novickiene added.
